entries.result_summary: Within the audited reduced ODE, the isolated track increases from P=0.500 s to 0.662 s, whereas the recycling track reaches P_min=0.226 s during accretion and ends at 0.281 s after resumed dipole spin-down. This establishes model-internal directional separation, but does not by itself validate population-level n-tau_c discrimination because the executable MathIR contains two deterministic tracks rather than the documented Monte Carlo outer loop.
